name: idea-to-finished claim into logomark reveal and wordmark lockup
looks: A claim about going from idea to finished work sits over a loose field of small marks and a soft circle, out of which a textured, halftone silhouette gathers and resolves into a solid brand mark. It cuts to the full name set beneath the mark with a small founding year, then holds on that lockup as a closing line about moving forward together settles in, fading to black.
build: The mark gathers from a grain/stipple fill condensing into a solid silhouette (the noise-dissolve-logomark mechanic); the lockup types the name in under the mark with a small kicker year (the wordmark-assemble mechanic); the whole hold runs under the film's constant grain-vignette texture before a fade to black.
sound: A soft granular shimmer as the mark resolves into a confident thunk, a warm pad under the lockup, the bed fading out into the final black.
prompt: Over a claim about carrying an idea through to a finished piece, let a loose, grainy field of marks gather and resolve into a solid brand silhouette, then set the full name beneath it with a small founding year, holding the calm, confident lockup as a short closing line settles in before the fade to black.
